api/src/services/artifact_retention.py.name: Attachment clean-up
api/src/services/artifact_retention.py.description: Sets how long chat attachments are kept and deletes the ones past their time.

api/src/services/artifacts.py.name: Chat attachments
api/src/services/artifacts.py.description: Stores files made or attached during chats and shows each one only to people allowed to see it.

api/src/services/file_backend.py.name: File storage switch
api/src/services/file_backend.py.description: Chooses whether files are kept on this machine or in cloud storage so the same commands work in both setups.

api/src/services/file_index_reconciler.p.name: Search index repair
api/src/services/file_index_reconciler.p.description: Compares the file search index with the files actually stored and fixes anything that has drifted apart.

api/src/services/file_index_service.py.name: File search index
api/src/services/file_index_service.py.description: Keeps the searchable list of workspace files up to date as files are added, changed or removed.

api/src/services/file_policy_service.py.name: File access rules
api/src/services/file_policy_service.py.description: Decides who may read, change or move each file and folder, and checks those rules everywhere.

api/src/services/file_storage/__init__.p.name: Workspace files
api/src/services/file_storage/__init__.p.description: Gathers the pieces that read, write, move and tidy the files people keep in their workspace.

api/src/services/file_storage/ast_parser.name: Workflow file reader
api/src/services/file_storage/ast_parser.description: Reads the labels on workflow and tool code so the platform can list and connect them.

api/src/services/file_storage/code_surge.name: Remove code block
api/src/services/file_storage/code_surge.description: Deletes one workflow or function from a file cleanly, leaving the rest of the file intact.

api/src/services/file_storage/deactivati.name: Workflow off switch guard
api/src/services/file_storage/deactivati.description: Warns before a save would switch off a live workflow and offers a replacement instead.

api/src/services/file_storage/diagnostic.name: File problem alerts
api/src/services/file_storage/diagnostic.description: Spots problems in saved files and tells the person who made the change what needs fixing.

api/src/services/file_storage/entity_det.name: File type detector
api/src/services/file_storage/entity_det.description: Works out whether a file holds a workflow, a tool or plain notes that belong in the database.

api/src/services/file_storage/entity_res.name: Reference lookup
api/src/services/file_storage/entity_res.description: Matches names used in files to the actual workflow or agent records they point at.

api/src/services/file_storage/file_ops.p.name: Single file changes
api/src/services/file_storage/file_ops.p.description: Reads, writes, deletes and moves one file at a time while keeping its record in step.

api/src/services/file_storage/folder_ops.name: Folders and bulk actions
api/src/services/file_storage/folder_ops.description: Lists folders and moves or deletes many files at once.

api/src/services/file_storage/indexers/_.name: File cataloguing
api/src/services/file_storage/indexers/_.description: Brings together the readers that turn agent, form and workflow files into searchable records.

api/src/services/file_storage/indexers/a.name: Agent file indexer
api/src/services/file_storage/indexers/a.description: Reads agent definition files and keeps the saved agents matching what those files say.

api/src/services/file_storage/indexers/f.name: Form file indexer
api/src/services/file_storage/indexers/f.description: Reads form definition files and keeps the saved forms matching what those files say.

api/src/services/file_storage/indexers/w.name: Workflow file indexer
api/src/services/file_storage/indexers/w.description: Reads workflow and data-source code and keeps the matching records and their details up to date.

api/src/services/file_storage/models.py.name: File change results
api/src/services/file_storage/models.py.description: Describes what happened during a file change, including any warnings shown before saving.

api/src/services/file_storage/move_names.name: Rename suggestions
api/src/services/file_storage/move_names.description: Proposes the next free name, like 'report (2).pdf', when a file would land on an existing one.

api/src/services/file_storage/move.py.name: Moving one file
api/src/services/file_storage/move.py.description: Moves a single file to a new place safely, without leaving duplicates or half-copied versions.

api/src/services/file_storage/service.py.name: File workspace
api/src/services/file_storage/service.py.description: The one place every screen and workflow goes to read, save, move or remove workspace files.

api/src/services/file_structure_service..name: File structure listing
api/src/services/file_structure_service..description: Gives administrators a full view of every share, folder and file for support and audits.

api/src/services/media_generation.py.name: Image and video generation
api/src/services/media_generation.py.description: Creates images and short videos on request with the chosen AI provider and records what each one costs.

api/src/services/repo_storage.py.name: Workspace source storage
api/src/services/repo_storage.py.description: Keeps the workspace's code and configuration files in cloud storage alongside the apps that use them.
